title: Finite point tensor comparisons and all quotient squares
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D and a prime l!=p. For every finite extension E/Q_l and every n>=0, there exist simultaneous finite point tensor data F(E,n) [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-system]. Their source constraints are the recorded ones [def-sf-point-finite-source-constraints]; their tensor and unit maps satisfy the arbitrary K-flat representative normalization [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-finite-models]. For every n<=m they satisfy the canonical finite quotient tensor square [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-reduction], including n=m. The assertion contains only the finite stage; it has no integral or field-stage conclusion.

source.place: Tag 07A4, label lemma-pullback-tensor-product (the finite-level geometric fibre case); at the integral, rational and common finite-field stages use the coefficient constructions of def-weil-finite-coefficient-point and def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-point-ringed-evaluation-model] to the finite coefficient ring sheaf. It identifies the exact sections fibre with the actual ringed-point derived pullback, with its canonical tensor, coefficient unit, signed constraints and scalar squares. By [lem-sf-tensor-ctf](ii) the tensor of the two finite-Tor inputs is still finite-Tor constructible. This gives the finite comparison and its finite reduction squares. Identify the specified lifted constant-section map by composing the unlifted coefficient identification with ULift.down. Restrict the ambient constraints, and retain the specified comparison on every arbitrary K-flat representative by comparison with a flat-term resolution. Quotient squares are checked on the balanced tensor generators before localization, including m=n.

lean.statement:
theorem pointFiniteTensorComparisons
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    ∃ F : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ), PointFiniteTensorData D l E n,
      (∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
        [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ),
        PointFiniteSourceConstraints D l E n (F E n) ∧
          PointFiniteTensorCanonical D l E n (F E n)) ∧
      ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
        [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
        PointFiniteTensorReductionData D l E h (F E m) (F E n)
